general_information.Time Allocation: 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
general_information.Description: This course focuses on the managerial aspects of information assurance which is commonly known as a process – a continuous series (or chain) of projects. Topics covered include access control models, information assurance governance, and information assurance program assessment and metrics. Coverage on the foundational and technical components of information assurance is included to reinforce key concepts. Students will learn how to properly manage security projects by going through the well-established project management, systems analysis and design practices, with special attention to the unique requirements found in security projects. Students will learn also basic skills and knowledge for a preparation of successful Capstone Projects.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Students are responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit in time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FPTU LMS at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/
general_information.Tools: Internet access, MS Office 2007 or higher, Adobe PDF reader.

description: This course focuses on the managerial aspects of information assurance which is commonly known as a process – a continuous series (or chain) of projects. Topics covered include access control models, information assurance governance, and information assurance program assessment and metrics. Coverage on the foundational and technical components of information assurance is included to reinforce key concepts. Students will learn how to properly manage security projects by going through the well-established project management, systems analysis and design practices, with special attention to the unique requirements found in security projects. Students will learn also basic skills and knowledge for a preparation of successful Capstone Projects.

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Identify and describe basic project management practices and techniques; understand the significance of the project manager’s role in the success of a security project.
Understand the importance, benefits, desired outcomes of security governance and the principal components of security system implementation planning.
Understand three major types of security policy and the process of developing, implementing, and maintaining various types of information security policies.
Understand the role of project management in security and how to plan, staff and manage an organization’s information security program.
Apply risk management methods and tools to a security project.
Recommend a security management model and explain how it can be customized to meet the needs of a particular organization.
Describe the key components and identify suitable strategies for the implementation of a security performance measurement program.
Describe the major components of incident response, disaster recovery and business continuity; define the components of crisis management and business resumption.
Identify the skills and requirements for security positions; discuss and implement security constraints on the general hiring processes.
Identify common control approaches and describe the types of intrusion detection and prevention systems and the strategies on which they are based.
